capabilities: Draw print-style Go boards as positions, numbered figures and problems
Edit stones, variations, marks and territory as SGF
Solve interactive problems with correct and incorrect verdicts
Import games and problems from OGS, goproblems.com, Josekipedia and Sensei's Library
Open and embed .sgf files in notes, tabs and Bases cards
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.13 or later; one ~140 kB file with no libraries; reads nothing outside the vault and goes online only to fetch a game, problem or file the user asked for; optional What's-new window loads its animations from GitHub.
problem: Obsidian has no way to draw, play through or solve Go board diagrams, or to open and edit SGF game records inside notes.

relations.evidence: Run Kifu: Import a game or puzzle from online-go.com
Run Kifu: Import a problem from goproblems.com
run Kifu: Import a joseki from Josekipedia
run Kifu: Import a diagram from Sensei's Library
Bruno Bouzy's dilations and erosions, as GNU Go uses them

summary: Print-style Go (baduk, weiqi) board renderer that draws positions, numbered figures and interactive problems in notes, stored as SGF.
